fact: The National Treasury states that IFMIS is the core system used by national MDAs and county governments and is being re-engineered, with payroll, e-GP, e-Citizen revenue and payment systems to be integrated and accrual go-live expected 1 July 2025.
title: Roadmap on Transition from Cash to Accrual Accounting by National and County Governments and their respective entities with effect from 1st July 2024 to 30th June 2027
publisher: The National Treasury and Economic Planning
